messages:
samira: Quick heads-up — we've got recurrent kvcache timeouts in prod (seen yesterday evening). Need an urgent 1.12.5 hotfix: minimal diff only, aim to cut today at 18:00 PT. Who can own branch + smoke?

eli: I can own the branch and cherry-pick. Will spin up hotfix/1.12.5 from release-1.12 and open a PR. ETA ~30m.

jordan: I'll take changelog + backport checklist. Keep it lightweight, no dep bumps.

mike: I can run smoke + quick perf on staging once PR is merged. Which test exactly?

samira: @mike run `kvcache/integration:timeout_test` and a short QPS ramp. @eli tag me in the PR. No feature flags, no migrations.

eli: Branch created and PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/1423
Cherry-pick steps I used:
```
git checkout -b hotfix/1.12.5 release-1.12
git cherry-pick abcdef1
# local test, push 
git push origin hotfix/1.12.5
```
PR contains minimal change + test.

jordan: Drafted changelog blurb in the PR description: "Fix kvcache timeout under high concurrency causing tokenization stalls." No BREAKING note.

devops: I'll reserve a canary slot for 18:10-18:40 PT. Rollback plan: immediate revert to tag release-1.12 if canary fails. Confirming no DB migrations.

qa-bot: Automated suites queued for PR #1423 — unit ~12m, integration ~8m. Will post final status here.

release-bot: Hotfix checklist: [ ] PR review, [ ] CI green, [ ] Smoke green, [ ] Tag & push, [ ] Deploy canary, [ ] Monitor 30m.

mike: CI finished and passed for #1423. Starting smoke now (staging).

mike: Smoke passed on staging (quick logs snippet: `kvcache: ok, latency P99 ~ 45ms, no timeouts`). :thumbsup:

samira: Good. We'll merge at 17:45 PT to give time for tagging and network rollout. @devops please start canary at 18:10.

devops: Canary started at 18:11 PT — routing 2% traffic to hotfix/1.12.5.

mike: Observability looks stable first 10m, no new kvcache errors. Latency steady.

jordan: Release notes pushed to /docs/releases/1.12.5.md and linked from the PR.

samira: If we get no rollback by 18:40 we'll promote to full release. Thanks everyone — will post a short postmortem if anything noteworthy shows up.

eli: Thanks — leaving the branch pinned until promotion. Ping me if we need fast rollback.

release-bot: Promotion checklist updated: canary ok -> ready to promote.

mike: Final note: keeping an eye on 5m error rate and kvcache retrials; will call immediate rollback if errors spike.

samira: Perfect. Closing coordination thread, will follow up in #postmortems if needed. :white_check_mark:
